notes.title: May 13 - Patch notes
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes for Decamped on May 13th:

[list]
[*] Added a control tab to the options - Set mouse sensitivity and bindings for select actions
[*] Added loading screens between levels
[*] Fixed some collision issues
[*] Movable object rotation and objective fixes
[*] Fixed some puzzle sequencing issues
[*] + several other fixes
[/list]

We hope this fixes most of the problems players were having, but are still monitoring potential issues. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Decamped Launch bugs
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have just launched the game and are thrilled with the amount of support we are getting. The fact that we have players across the world buying and playing our game means the world to us! We've also seen a lot of gameplay videos on Youtube and are aware of the bugs in our game. We appreciate your feedback and are working on fixing some minor and major bugs throughout the game. Some bugs we are working on includes

[list]
[*] Inconsistent audio levels
[*] UI visibility issues
[*] Generator issues in subway level
[*] Lighting issues in city level
[*] Achievement fixes
[*] Terrain collision fixes
[*] Cutscene trigger placements
[*] Object physics
[*] More puzzle bugs
[/list]

We understand that there will be bugs that we have missed which is why we ask for your patience as we iron everything out. If you have any bugs to report that we haven't mentioned, please don't hesitate to reach out to us either! We want to ensure everyone has a smooth experience playing our game, and hopefully these upcoming fixes will solve most of the major issues. Again, we thank you for your support on launch and will be reaching out again soon!

Thank you,
Sobek Games.
